package storage

import (
    \"context\"
    \"testing\"

    flipt \"github.com/markphelps/flipt/rpc\"
    \"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert\"
    \"github.com/stretchr/testify/require\"
)

func TestEvaluatorUsesLowestRank(t *testing.T) {
    ctx := context.Background()
    flag, err := flagStore.CreateFlag(ctx, &flipt.CreateFlagRequest{Key: t.Name(), Name: t.Name(), Enabled: true})
    require.NoError(t, err)

    for _, item := range []struct{ suffix string; rank int32 }{{\"second\", 2}, {\"first\", 1}} {
        key := t.Name() + item.suffix
        _, err := segmentStore.CreateSegment(ctx, &flipt.CreateSegmentRequest{Key: key, Name: key})
        require.NoError(t, err)
        _, err = ruleStore.CreateRule(ctx, &flipt.CreateRuleRequest{FlagKey: flag.Key, SegmentKey: key, Rank: item.rank})
        require.NoError(t, err)
    }

    for i := 0; i < 10; i++ {
        resp, err := evaluatorStore.Evaluate(ctx, &flipt.EvaluationRequest{FlagKey: flag.Key, EntityId: \"entity\"})
        require.NoError(t, err)
        assert.True(t, resp.Match)
        assert.Equal(t, t.Name()+\"first\", resp.SegmentKey)
        assert.Empty(t, resp.Value)
    }
}

func TestEvaluationBoundaryAndTypedComparisons(t *testing.T) {
    assert.True(t, matchesString(constraint{Operator: \"EQ\", Value: \" bar \"}, \"bar \"))
    assert.True(t, matchesString(constraint{Operator: \"PREFIX\", Value: \" ba \"}, \" bar \"))
    assert.True(t, matchesString(constraint{Operator: \"SUFFIX\", Value: \" ar \"}, \" bar \"))
    match, err := matchesNumber(constraint{Operator: \"GTE\", Value: \" 2.5 \"}, \" 2.5 \")
    require.NoError(t, err)
    assert.True(t, match)
    _, err = matchesNumber(constraint{Operator: \"eq\", Value: \"2\"}, \"invalid\")
    require.Error(t, err)
    match, err = matchesBool(constraint{Operator: \"TRUE\"}, \" true \")
    require.NoError(t, err)
    assert.True(t, match)
    _, err = matchesBool(constraint{Operator: \"true\"}, \"invalid\")
    require.Error(t, err)

    var request *flipt.EvaluationRequest
    for i := 0; i < 100000; i++ {
        candidate := &flipt.EvaluationRequest{FlagKey: \"boundary\", EntityId: stringID(i)}
        if crc32Num(candidate.EntityId, candidate.FlagKey) == 500 {
            request = candidate
            break
        }
    }
    require.NotNil(t, request)
    ok, selected := evaluate(request, []distribution{{VariantKey: \"first\"}, {VariantKey: \"second\"}}, []int{500, 1000})
    assert.True(t, ok)
    assert.Equal(t, \"first\", selected.VariantKey)
}
EOF

item.text:
Introduced `Evaluator` and moved SQL evaluation into [storage/evaluator.go](/app/storage/evaluator.go). [Server.Evaluate](/app/server/evaluator.go) now delegates through that dependency; `RuleStore` handles rule storage only.

The evaluator applies rank ordered rules, typed constraints, and deterministic variant selection. I updated the existing tests and added coverage for rank precedence, rollout boundaries, and 0% distributions. `go test ./storage ./server` and `git diff --check` pass.
